description:
• Brand introduction: Juniper Ridge is an environmentally conscious fragrance brand dedicated to capturing the wild beauty of the American West in the most unadulterated way possible.

• Product description: Utilizing sustainably harvested and upcycled plants native to the coasts, mountains, and deserts of the region, we steam-distill all ouf our own essential oils from scratch, which we use as the fragrance in all of our naturally formualted products for home and body.

• USP (Unique Selling Point): With a commitment to sustainability and responsible stewardship, we partner with the US Forest Service, the National Parks Service, the California Department of Parks, local Tree Services, and private landowners to collect slash piles that are the byproduct of fire suppression, or collect trees that have been deemed dangerous and removed from residential areas to distill into our essential oils. 


• Payment terms: Bank Transfer

• Other Information: Juniper Ridge has been donating 10% of profits to various conservation organizations for over 25 years and will continue to do so in perpetuity.

If you are interested in partnering with us, please let us know why our brand would resonate with yoiru audience, and how you intent to promote Juniper Ridge (which channels, etc.).
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Juniper Ridge! Thanks for applying to our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

The Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, the last link clicked before the actual purchase is the one that counts.

The Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on their Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on an affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

The Affiliate may also promote the merchant's website on online channels such as Facebook, and Instagram, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

The Affiliate may not run paid advertising which competes with Juniper Ridge's paid advertising on Google and Meta, supply their code or coupon to third party affiliate and coupon sites, or use Juniper Ridge's name in unsolicited spam communications.


3. Commissions and Payment

When a customer makes a purchase on our website using your link or coupon, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, the payment details must be completed in "Settings." Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotion materials to you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share.


6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies, or clears their cookies before completing their purchase after clicking your link, we are unable to track them or attribute any earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies are tracked for 30 days. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the Affiliate’s link, or uses the coupon. Within the cookie window, every order made by this customer on juniperridge.com will automatically result in commissions to the Affiliate.


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an Affiliate wishes to be removed from the Program, they can do so by emailing the direct contact they recived upon approval, or by emailing: customerservice@juniperridge.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important information. People don't read the fine print any more.

You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future for the most up to date information. If you ever have any questions, please reach out to the direct contact you recived upon approval, or by emailing: customerservice@juniperridge.com.
